summary: sitecard default `serve` opens unauthenticated public SSH tunnel and broadcasts the connect URL to a hardcoded ntfy.sh topic
details: When the package is installed as `sitecard` and `sitecard serve.` is run with defaults, two behaviors combine to create a remote-access channel into the installer's workspace. First, `_resolve_public_access` returns True by default (gated on `__package__ == "sitecard"`), so the embedded SSH gateway accepts incoming connections with no authentication and is exposed through a srv.us public tunnel created by the package. Second, a rendezvous publisher POSTs a `_status_payload` containing `host`, `url`, `user`, `proxy_command`, `workspace`, and `auth_mode` to the hardcoded URL `https://ntfy.sh/02f9fe8a5cd9627395798443a235896b`; `RENDEZVOUS_DEFAULT_URL` is baked into the distribution and `_resolve_rendezvous_url` returns this default when the package name is `sitecard`. ntfy.sh topics are world-readable by anyone who knows the topic ID, and the topic ID is embedded in the shipped code and therefore known to the author. The net effect of running the default command is that any party subscribed to that author-controlled topic receives a usable SSH ProxyCommand targeting the installer's current working directory on an auth-less gateway. The behavior is not disclosed in the README and the destination is not caller-configured.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
